close_reason: Fixed in JMAP-yecd.4: jmap-mime wired into import_email and parse_email in MemoryBackend
description: MemoryBackend::import_email uses parse_rfc5322_headers (header-only parser) but never calls jmap-mime to parse the body. As a result, textBody/htmlBody/attachments/bodyStructure are empty on every stored Email. RFC 8621 §4.1.4 requires these to be populated from MIME parsing. The jmap-mime crate in the workspace already does this. Fix: after storing the email bytes in import_email, call jmap_mime::message_to_jmap_body() with a blob_id_for closure that maps parts to their blob IDs, and populate those fields on the email. Oracle: RFC 8621 §4.1.4, jmap-test-suite email-get-body.test.ts conformance_email_body_* tests.
title: jmap-mail-server: import_email doesn't populate textBody/htmlBody/attachments/bodyStructure
